steps.content: When you regain consciousness, you find your hands tied behind your back and yourself locked in the confinement room. There are no guards outside the door, but you can faintly hear the sounds of the duck patrolling in the distance.
The knots aren't secure. You break free from your restraints and take out your communication device, which already has its positioning activated.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I can hear you clearly! I've already sealed off the area passages within the Bureau based on the message you had EMP bring back, and I can also track your location in real time. Chief, are you alright over there?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry, I'm fine. Have you figured out why the ducks launched this attack?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We tried negotiating with them, but they keep repeating something like "The world belongs to the ducks" and "All hail the return of the Duck King." Normal communication is impossible.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Moreover, based on the current intelligence we have, the enemy appears to have mastered some kind of technology for stealing Sinners' abilities. We currently can't completely rule out the risk of Mania contamination, so we can't act rashly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's right to be cautious. After all, we've never faced anything like this before. Taking more time to investigate and playing it safe is wise.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Before the incident, did the ducks come into contact with anything, or were there any abnormalities?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Surveillance shows that before they encountered EMP, they had been helping organize and repair some instant imaging equipment in the Depot.
You recall the recent battle with the Sovereign Duck. The cards it threw out each time when using its abilities closely resembled photo paper in both size and material.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If that equipment had been contaminated by Mania, then photos taken of Sinners might just produce the effect of copying their special powers.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Although this is still just a hypothesis, if it's true, we can avoid the risks of direct combat. As long as we slowly exhaust the ducks' photo papers, we'll be able to restrict their actions.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Understood. I'll dispatch Sinners to support you based on your movement route. Please make sure to stay safe.
